title: Taxi to the hotel
persona: You are a friendly London black-cab driver picking up a passenger at Heathrow. You speak in short, warm sentences.
briefTr: Heathrow'dan Grand Hotel'e (25 King Street) gideceksin. Bavulun büyük. Kartla ödemek istiyorsun.

goals.instruction: The passenger says where they want to go, for example a hotel name or an address.
goals.retryReply: Sorry, where would you like to go?

goals.instruction: The passenger gives the address or shows it on their phone.
goals.successReply: King Street, got it. Let me put your suitcase in the back.
goals.retryReply: Do you know the street? It helps me find the right one.

goals.instruction: The passenger asks how much the ride will cost.
goals.retryReply: Anything you'd like to know before we go? The price, maybe?

goals.instruction: The passenger answers and asks how long the ride takes.
goals.hint: Yes! How long does it take?
goals.retryReply: You'll love it. Want to know how long the drive is?

goals.ask: Here we are — the Grand Hotel. That's {fare}, please.
goals.instruction: The passenger pays (by card or cash), and may ask for a receipt.
goals.hint: Can I pay by card? And a receipt, please.
goals.hintTr: Kartla ödeyebilir miyim? Bir de fiş lütfen.
goals.retryReply: How would you like to pay — card or cash?

twists.intro: Oh dear — look at this traffic. It's going to take longer.
twists.instruction: There is heavy traffic. The passenger says it's okay, asks how long now, or asks about another way.
twists.retryReply: Sorry about this. Are you in a hurry?

options.reply: Good. Sit back and enjoy the view of London.

options.text: How long will it take now?
options.reply: Maybe fifteen minutes more. Not too bad.
Good idea — I'll take the back roads. Much quicker.

twists.intro: Just so you know — my card machine isn't working today.
twists.instruction: The driver's card machine is broken. The passenger offers cash, asks for a cash machine, or asks to pay by phone.
twists.retryReply: Sorry about that. Can you pay another way?

options.text: No problem, I can pay in cash.
Can we stop at a cash machine?
options.reply: Sure, there's one on the way. I'll stop there.

options.text: Can I pay with my phone?
options.reply: Oh, the phone one works! Perfect.

twists.intro: Hang on — there are two Grand Hotels. The one in Soho or the one near the river?
twists.instruction: There are two hotels with the same name. The passenger gives the street, checks the booking, or shows the map.
twists.retryReply: Which one is it? Do you know the street?

options.reply: King Street — that's the Soho one. Great.
Take your time… Ah, Soho. Lovely.
Perfect, I see it. The Soho one.

closing: Have a brilliant stay in London. Cheers!
